explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with `next_token()` and `get_current_depth()` to collect only `#text` tokens inside each heading opener, flushing when the processor depth drops below the heading’s opener depth. This follows the documented HTML Processor subtree-walk and text-extraction APIs, and preserves heading order and empty headings.
